pairs.said: So the temperature is still high, but it's getting a little lower, going low.
pairs.natural: So the temperature is still high, but it's starting to cool down a bit.

pairs.said: Yeah, that's normal, but it's so special for me. It's so nice.
pairs.natural: It was a simple outing, but it felt very special to me.

pairs.said: So if I want, I will go to a different beach, because we have different beaches.
pairs.natural: So I can visit a different beach whenever I want, because there are many.
